context: Banchi cannot always tell a card's printing, or a price looks far from recent sales. Either way the card stays a draft and the app asks one question with big answers, with the reason on the card. C1 shows these behind a "2 to check" filter in the stack list. C3 shows them as a deck, one card at a time. All screens, both Duo poses and themes: designs/d4-banchi-phone-v2/phone-blind-1.html (open one with #s=c3-full) and its notes on the roadmap branch. All cards, orders and buyers are made up. Unmeasured: the unfolded Duo height and insets and the folded top inset (drawn 644 pt).

options.gain: You see them in context, beside the cards that are fine.
options.how: The few cards sit among the rest of the list; one press on the filter shows only them.
options.label: A "2 to check" filter in the stack
options.lose: A list to scroll; the question is smaller than in the deck.

options.gain: Your attention goes only to cards that need a person, one at a time.
options.how: One card, one question ("Which printing is it?"), big answers, and "Not sure: keep as draft" (the picture shows the unfolded desk).
options.label: A one-card deck
options.lose: No view of the other cards; the reason on each card must be clear or the question is noise.
